title: Status and tracking changes are refused when saved without Delete
custom_preconds: 1. A user WITHOUT "Part Library & Inventory - Delete". (Server enforcement - AUTOMATION: the "any route" part is verified beyond the UI.)
custom_steps:
1. As that user, attempt to save an untracked part by any route.
  2. Attempt to change a part's tracking state by any route.
  3. Attempt to set a part active or inactive by any route.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A user without the delete-level setting who tries to save an untracked part, change a tracking state, or set a part active/inactive by any route (including a direct call to the system) is refused with an access denied error.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 8 (Permissions); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N1: “If a user without the delete-level setting tries to save an untracked part by any route, including a direct call to the system, the request is refused with an access denied error.”
  • S8-N2: “If such a user tries to change a part's tracking state by any route, the request is refused with an access denied error.”
  • S8-N3: “If such a user tries to set a part active or inactive by any route, the request is refused with an access denied error.”
